name: jotley
description: Read and work with your Jotley notes on this Mac.
long_description: Connect Claude chat to the Jotley Mac app. Keep Jotley open with MCP access enabled. Jotley controls read-only or read-and-write access, including notes, tags, folders and custom summary templates. Connected agents may send retrieved text to their AI provider.

access_token.title: Jotley access token
access_token.description: In Jotley, open Settings → Integrations → MCP and click Copy access token. Paste it here. Keep Jotley open while connected.
